description: ChartMogul account, customers, contacts, data sources, tags and metrics.

chartmogul_new_contacts_trigger.description: Runs each time a contact is created in ChartMogul. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields uuid, first_name, last_name, email, customer_uuid

chartmogul_new_customers_trigger.description: Runs each time a customer is created in ChartMogul. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields uuid, external_id, name, email, data_source_uuid, created_at, updated_at, attributes

chartmogul_new_data_sources_trigger.description: Runs each time a data source is created in ChartMogul. Ones created before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields uuid, name, system, created_at, status

chartmogul_new_or_updated_contacts_trigg.description: Runs for each contact added or changed in ChartMogul. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields uuid, first_name, last_name, email, customer_uuid

chartmogul_new_or_updated_customers_trig.description: Runs for each customer added or changed in ChartMogul. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields uuid, external_id, name, email, data_source_uuid, created_at, updated_at, attributes

chartmogul_new_or_updated_data_sources_t.description: Runs for each data source added or changed in ChartMogul. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields uuid, name, system, created_at, status
